ASE A7 Heating Air Conditioning Practice Test
51. The clutch air gap in the illustration is above specifications. Technician A says this will result in a scraping noise when the clutch is engaged. Technician B says to use a feeler gauge to measure this gap. Who is correct?

- B. Technician B
- C. Both A and B
